text: On the integers, a relation R is defined by a R b if $a - b$ is divisible by 2. Show that R is an equivalence relation.

points.text: Reflexive: $a - a = 0$ is divisible by 2.

Transitive: if $a - b = 2m$ and $b - c = 2n$, then $a - c = 2(m + n)$. So R is an equivalence relation.
